scope_rules.role_gate: Intent is only offered if the caller's role is listed in `roles`. Mirrors ROLE_ACCESS in lib/role-access.ts.
scope_rules.vertical_gate: Intent is only offered if active journey is in `verticals`. 'all' means available in every journey for unrestricted roles.
scope_rules.property_scope: All read/write SQL must be filtered by caller's assigned_property_ids unless role is super_admin/executive/platform_super_admin.
scope_rules.write_guard: Intents with action_type=write require the equivalent mutation permission. High/critical intents need typed confirmation.
scope_rules.audit: Every write intent is appended to audit_logs / system_audit_events with actor, role, ip, and payload.

risk_levels.low: Read-only or non-destructive self-service; no confirmation.
risk_levels.medium: Creates or updates a normal record; single confirmation on ambiguous entities.
risk_levels.high: Financial, access, pricing, or org-structure mutation; typed confirmation required.
risk_levels.critical: Irreversible or high-impact (voids, refunds, payroll, tenant lifecycle, OTA broadcast); manager approval + typed confirmation.
